data.title: XRP ETF Inflows Beat Bitcoin, Ethereum Again: What Is Going On?
data.description: XRP (CRYPTO: XRP) spot ETFs pulled in $3.50 million over two days with zero outflows while Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) and Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) funds bled $1.11 billion combined.What the ETF Flows ShowFranklin Templeton’s XRPZ (NYSE:XRPZ) drove the entire Sept. 16 inflow, adding 2.71 million XRP worth…
